exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni mashhur odamlarning ismlari bilan nomlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMI: 'The Price of Fame' = Shuhratning narxi
  fame  = shuhrat, mashhurlik
  price = narx
  Ma'nosi: mashhur bo'lish uchun to'lanadigan 'narx' —
  shaxsiy hayotning yo'qolishi, bosim, yolg'izlik.

ETTI ISM:
  Diana Spencer, Leonardo da Vinci, John F. Kennedy,
  Marie Curie, Elvis Presley, Elizabeth I, Rudolf Nureyev

ETTI RASM (kasbi va yillari bilan):
  A  Queen of England (1533 - 1603)
  B  Polish scientist (1867 - 1934)
  C  Russian ballet dancer (1938 - 1993)
  D  American president (1917 - 1963)
  E  American singer and actor (1935 - 1977)
  F  Italian artist (1452 - 1519)
  G  Princess of Wales (1961 - 1997)

USUL: kasb va millatga qarab ismni toping.

DIQQAT — 'ELIZABETH I' O'QILISHI:
  Yozilishi: Elizabeth I
  O'qilishi: 'Elizabeth the First'
  Qirol va qirolichalar raqami TARTIB SON bilan o'qiladi:
     Henry VIII → Henry the Eighth
     Elizabeth II → Elizabeth the Second

tasks.whyUz:
ELIZABETH I (Elizabeth the First) — 1558-1603-yillarda
Angliya qirolichasi bo'lgan.
Rasmda katta sariq ko'ylakdagi ayol.
'Queen' = qirolicha.

MARIE CURIE — polshalik olima, radiy va poloniyni kashf etgan.
Ikki marta Nobel mukofotini olgan yagona ayol.
'Polish' = polshalik;  'a scientist' = olim.

RUDOLF NUREYEV — rus (Boshqirdistonda tug'ilgan) balet raqqosi.
Rasmda sahnada gullar orasida yotgan raqqos.
'a ballet dancer' = balet raqqosi.

JOHN F. KENNEDY — AQShning 35-prezidenti.
2-mashqdagi NAMUNA aynan shu odam haqida.
'F.' = Fitzgerald (o'rta ism).

ELVIS PRESLEY — 'the king of rock'n'roll'.
Workbook 37-betdagi 5-mashqda ham uchragan.
'a singer' = qo'shiqchi;  'an actor' = aktyor.

LEONARDO DA VINCI — italyan rassomi, ixtirochisi, olimi.
Rasmda uzun oq soqolli qariya.
'an artist' = rassom, san'atkor.

DIANA SPENCER — Uels malikasi (Princess of Wales).
Uning tarjimai holi 71-betda o'qiladi.
'a princess' = malika, shahzoda qizi.

exercises.instructionEn: Ask and answer questions about these people, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu odamlar haqida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: Who was John F. Kennedy?
  S2: He was an American president. When was he born?
  S3: He was born in 1917. When did he die?
  S4: He died in 1963.

UCHTA SAVOL QOLIPI:

  1) WHO WAS + ism?          → Kim edi?
     Javob: He/She WAS + kasb.

  2) WHEN WAS he/she BORN?   → Qachon tug'ilgan?
     Javob: He/She WAS BORN IN + yil.

  3) WHEN DID he/she DIE?    → Qachon vafot etgan?
     Javob: He/She DIED IN + yil.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — 'BE BORN':
  Ingliz tilida 'tug'ilmoq' — MAJHUL nisbatda:
     I WAS BORN in 2010.        ✓
     I BORN in 2010.            ✗ XATO
     I WAS BORNED in 2010.      ✗ XATO
  So'zma-so'z: 'tug'ilgan bo'ldim'.

DIQQAT — 'DIE' esa ODDIY fe'l:
  He DIED in 1963.        ✓
  He WAS DIED in 1963.    ✗ XATO
  So'roqda: 'When DID he DIE?' — 'did' + asosiy shakl.

DIQQAT — YIL OLDIDAN 'IN':
  in 1917, in 1963 — yil oldidan DOIM IN.

DIQQAT — KASB OLDIDAN ARTIKL:
  He was AN American president.  (bir nechtadan biri → A/AN)
  She was THE Queen of England.  (o'sha davrda YAGONA → THE)
  She was THE Princess of Wales. (yagona unvon → THE)

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'an American' — 'A' unli tovush → AN.
'was born' — majhul nisbat, 'died' — oddiy o'tgan zamon.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and mark them T (true) or F (false). Who is this woman?
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglab T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang. Bu ayol kim?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOB — BU AYOL KIM?
  DIANA SPENCER, Princess of Wales (1961 - 1997).
  Uning to'liq tarjimai holi 71-betda o'qiladi.

Kitob 1-bandning javobini BERGAN: F.
Qolganlari audioda aytiladi, lekin 71-betdagi
tarjimai holdan ham tekshirsa bo'ladi.

DIANA HAQIDA ASOSIY FAKTLAR:
  • 1961-yilda tug'ilgan
  • IKKITA katta opasi va bitta kichik ukasi bor edi
  • bolalar bog'chasida ishlagan (hamshira EMAS)
  • 1981-yilda shahzoda Charlz bilan turmush qurgan
  • britaniyaliklar uni mehribonligi va go'zalligi uchun sevgan
  • 1996-yilda ajrashgan
  • 1997-yilda Parijda AVTOHALOKATDA halok bo'lgan

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an older sister = katta opa
  a nurse         = hamshira
  kindness        = mehribonlik
  beauty          = go'zallik
  an accident     = baxtsiz hodisa, halokat

tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI — KITOBDA BERILGAN JAVOB.
Diananing IKKITA katta opasi (Sara va Jeyn) va
bitta kichik ukasi (Charlz) bor edi.
'three' emas, 'two'.
'an older sister' = katta opa (aksi: a younger sister).

NOTO'G'RI.
Diana LONDONDAGI BOLALAR BOG'CHASIDA ishlagan
(kindergarten assistant), hamshira sifatida EMAS.
'a nurse' = hamshira.
'to work AS a ...' = ... bo'lib ishlamoq — 'as' shart.

tasks.prompt: 3  The British loved her for her kindness and beauty.
tasks.whyUz:
TO'G'RI.
Diana xayriya ishlari, kasallarga g'amxo'rligi va
go'zalligi bilan xalq mehrini qozongan.
'the British' = britaniyaliklar (millat nomi oldidan THE —
69-betdagi qoida).
'kindness' = mehribonlik (kind + -ness).
'beauty' = go'zallik (beautiful ning oti).
tasks.speak: 3  The British loved her for her kindness and beauty.

tasks.prompt: 4  She died in a train accident.
tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI.
Diana 1997-yil 31-avgustda PARIJDA AVTOHALOKATDA
(a car accident) halok bo'lgan, poyezdda emas.
'an accident' = baxtsiz hodisa, halokat.
'to die IN an accident' — predlog IN.
tasks.speak: 4  She died in a train accident.

exercises.instructionEn: Explain the verbs in the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N TO'RT FE'L — HAMMASI O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
  died, divorced, watched, studied, married, continued,
  returned, loved, said, worked, cared, completed,
  called, appeared

Bu fe'llar 71-betdagi Diananing tarjimai holidagi
bo'shliqlarga qo'yiladi.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — ODDIY O'TGAN ZAMON:
  Ko'pchilik fe'lga -ED qo'shiladi:
     work → worked;  love → loved;  study → studied

  -ED QO'ShIShNING UCH QOIDASI:
     1) oddiy holat        → + ED    (work → worked)
     2) oxirida -E bo'lsa  → + D     (love → loved,
                                      divorce → divorced)
     3) undosh + Y bo'lsa  → Y→I+ED  (study → studied)

  ISTISNO — NOTO'G'RI FE'L:
     say → SAID  (-ed QO'ShILMAYDI!)
     Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA noto'g'ri fe'l.

-ED NING UCH XIL O'QILISHI:
  /t/  — jarangsiz tovushdan keyin: worked, watched
  /d/  — jarangli tovushdan keyin: loved, called, appeared
  /ɪd/ — 't' yoki 'd' dan keyin: completed, divorced?
         (aniq: wanted /ˈwɒntɪd/, needed /ˈniːdɪd/)

tasks.en: Explain the verbs in the list.

tasks.note:
die → died.
Oxiridagi -e ga faqat -D qo'shiladi.
DIQQAT: -ing shaklida 'dying' (ie → y).

divorce → divorced.
'to divorce somebody' = kimdandir ajrashmoq.
'a divorce' = ajralish (ot).

watch → watched.
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.
68-betda ham: 'someone is watching us'.

study → studied.
Undosh + Y → Y I ga aylanadi + ED.
Shunga o'xshash: carry → carried, try → tried.

marry → married (Y → I + ED).
'to marry somebody' — 'with' KERAK EMAS:
  She married Charles.       ✓
  She married WITH Charles.  ✗ XATO

continue → continued (-e ga faqat -D).
'to continue' = davom etmoq, davom ettirmoq.

return → returned.
're-' = qayta;  'turn' = burilmoq.
'to return TO a place' = biror joyga qaytmoq.

love → loved (-e ga faqat -D).
-ed /d/ deb o'qiladi.

say → SAID — NOTO'G'RI fe'l!
Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA -ed olmaydigan fe'l.
O'qilishi /sed/ ('seyd' EMAS).

work → worked.
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.
'to work AS a nurse' = hamshira bo'lib ishlamoq.

care → cared (-e ga faqat -D).
'to care FOR somebody' = kimgadir g'amxo'rlik qilmoq.
'to care ABOUT something' = biror narsaga befarq bo'lmaslik.
'careful' = ehtiyotkor.

complete → completed (-e ga faqat -D).
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (chunki oxiri 't').
'complete' sifat sifatida = to'liq, tugallangan.

call → called.
UCH ma'no:
  call somebody = chaqirmoq / qo'ng'iroq qilmoq
  be called X = X deb atalmoq
68-betda: 'they called us from the reception desk'.

appear → appeared.
'to appear' = paydo bo'lmoq, ko'rinmoq.
Aksi: 'to disappear' = g'oyib bo'lmoq.
Televideniye haqida: 'to appear on TV' = televizorda chiqmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: A Fairy-Tale Princess — read the article.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A FAIRY-TALE PRINCESS

  It was like a fairy tale when the beautiful young girl
  married the Prince and became the Princess of Wales.
  Unlike a fairy tale, the happiness soon ended, but Diana
  was still The People's Princess.

  1) Diana Frances Spencer was born on 1st July, 1961, in
     Norfolk, England. Her father was Earl Spencer. She had
     two older sisters and a younger brother. Her parents
     DIVORCED when she was a young girl. As a child, Diana
     STUDIED at a boarding school in Kent. She COMPLETED
     her education in Switzerland. When she RETURNED to
     England she WORKED as a nanny in London.

  2) Diana MARRIED Prince Charles in July, 1981, at St
     Paul's Cathedral in London. People all around the world
     WATCHED her wedding on television. Charles and Diana
     had two sons, William and Harry.

  3) Diana was very popular. The British LOVED her for her
     kindness and beauty. They CALLED her "The People's
     Princess" because she CARED so much about sick and poor
     people all over the world. She once SAID, "I see myself
     as a princess for the world, not the Princess of
     Wales." Reporters were always around her. She was their
     favourite person.

  4) But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it APPEARED. She
     and Charles had problems with their marriage. They
     finally divorced in August, 1996.

  5) Diana CONTINUED to travel round the world and help
     those in need. But her life was short — she DIED in a
     car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris. She was
     only thirty-six years old.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  ERTAKDAGIDEK MALIKA

  Go'zal yosh qiz shahzodaga turmushga chiqib, Uels
  malikasi bo'lganida bu xuddi ertakdek edi. Lekin
  ertakdan farqli o'laroq, baxt tez orada tugadi —
  ammo Diana baribir Xalq Malikasi bo'lib qoldi.

  1) Diana Frensis Spenser 1961-yil 1-iyulda Angliyaning
     Norfolk shahrida tug'ilgan. Otasi Erl Spenser edi.
     Uning ikkita katta opasi va bitta kichik ukasi bor
     edi. U yosh qiz bo'lganida ota-onasi ajrashdi. Bolalik
     chog'ida Diana Kentdagi internat maktabida o'qidi.
     Ta'limini Shveytsariyada tugatdi. Angliyaga qaytgach,
     Londonda enaga bo'lib ishladi.

  2) Diana 1981-yil iyulda Londondagi Avliyo Pavel
     soborida shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi. Butun
     dunyo odamlari uning to'yini televizorda tomosha
     qilishdi. Charlz va Diananing ikkita o'g'li bor edi —
     Uilyam va Garri.

  3) Diana juda mashhur edi. Britaniyaliklar uni
     mehribonligi va go'zalligi uchun sevishardi. Ular uni
     "Xalq Malikasi" deb atashdi, chunki u butun dunyodagi
     kasal va kambag'al odamlar haqida juda qayg'urardi.
     U bir marta shunday degan edi: "Men o'zimni Uels
     malikasi emas, balki butun dunyo uchun malika deb
     bilaman." Jurnalistlar doim uning atrofida edi.
     U ularning sevimli shaxsi edi.

  4) Lekin Diananing hayoti ko'ringanchalik baxtli emas edi.
     U va Charlz nikohlarida muammolarga duch kelishdi.
     Ular nihoyat 1996-yil avgustda ajrashdilar.

  5) Diana dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishni va muhtojlarga
     yordam berishni davom ettirdi. Lekin uning umri qisqa
     bo'ldi — u 1997-yil 31-avgustda Parijda avtohalokatda
     halok bo'ldi. U atigi o'ttiz olti yoshda edi.


MATN TUZILISHI (5 xatboshi):
  1  Bolalik va ta'lim
  2  To'y va farzandlar
  3  Mashhurligi va xalq mehri
  4  Nikohdagi muammolar va ajralish
  5  Fojiali oxir

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  'The Price of Fame' — shuhratning narxi.
  Diana mashhur edi, lekin jurnalistlar doim atrofida edi
  va shaxsiy hayoti buzildi. Shuhratning 'narxi' shu.

tasks.en: A Fairy-Tale Princess — read the article.

'marry somebody' — 'with' KERAK EMAS.

'unlike' = ...dan farqli o'laroq (aksi: 'like').

'still' = baribir, hali ham.

tasks.en: Diana Frances Spencer was born on 1st July, 1961, in Norfolk, England.

tasks.en: She had two older sisters and a younger brother.

tasks.note:
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 1-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi:
'three older sisters' XATO — TWO.

tasks.en: As a child, Diana studied at a boarding school in Kent.
tasks.uz: Bolalik chog'ida Diana Kentdagi internat maktabida o'qidi.

'as a child' = bolaligida.
'a boarding school' = internat maktab (o'quvchilar yotib o'qiydi).

tasks.en: When she returned to England she worked as a nanny in London.

'a nanny' = enaga, bola boquvchi.

u HAMShIRA emas, ENAGA edi.

tasks.en: Diana married Prince Charles in July, 1981, at St Paul's Cathedral in London.
tasks.uz: Diana 1981-yil iyulda Londondagi Avliyo Pavel soborida shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.
tasks.note:
'a cathedral' = sobor, katta cherkov.
'IN July' (oy) — 'AT St Paul's Cathedral' (aniq bino).

tasks.en: People all around the world watched her wedding on television.
tasks.uz: Butun dunyo odamlari uning to'yini televizorda tomosha qilishdi.
tasks.note:
'a wedding' = to'y, nikoh marosimi.
'ON television' — predlog ON.

tasks.en: The British loved her for her kindness and beauty.
tasks.uz: Britaniyaliklar uni mehribonligi va go'zalligi uchun sevishardi.
tasks.note:
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi shu gapdan olingan (T).
'the British' — millat nomi oldidan THE.

tasks.en: They called her "The People's Princess" because she cared so much about sick and poor people.
tasks.uz: Ular uni "Xalq Malikasi" deb atashdi, chunki u kasal va kambag'al odamlar haqida juda qayg'urardi.
tasks.note:
'call somebody + nom' = kimnidir ... deb atamoq.
'care ABOUT' = qayg'urmoq, befarq bo'lmaslik.
'The People'S' — apostrof egalik bildiradi.

tasks.en: "I see myself as a princess for the world, not the Princess of Wales."
tasks.uz: "Men o'zimni Uels malikasi emas, balki butun dunyo uchun malika deb bilaman."
tasks.note:
Diananing o'z so'zlari (to'g'ri nutq).
'see myself AS' = o'zimni ...deb bilaman.

tasks.en: Reporters were always around her. She was their favourite person.
tasks.uz: Jurnalistlar doim uning atrofida edi. U ularning sevimli shaxsi edi.
tasks.note:
'a reporter' = jurnalist, muxbir.
SHUHRATNING NARXI shu — tinchlik yo'q.

tasks.note:
'AS happy AS' — tenglik darajasi.
'to appear' = ko'rinmoq (bu yerda 'aslida undoq emas' ma'nosida).

'finally' = nihoyat.
'divorce' bu yerda FE'L (ot sifatida 'a divorce').

tasks.en: She died in a car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris. She was only thirty-six years old.

exercises.instructionEn: Read Diana's biography and fill in the gaps with the correct verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Diananing tarjimai holini o'qing va bo'shliqlarni to'g'ri fe'llar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (70-betdan, 14 ta fe'l):
  died, divorced, watched, studied, married, continued,
  returned, loved, said, worked, cared, completed,
  called, appeared

14 fe'l, 14 bo'shliq — har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA.
Bu tekshirish uchun yaxshi belgi.

USUL: har bir bo'shliq atrofidagi so'zlarga qarang.
  ... at a boarding school → o'qish → studied
  ... as a nanny          → ishlash → worked
  ... in a car accident    → o'lim  → died

HAMMA FE'L O'TGAN ZAMONDA (-ed),
chunki matn tarixiy voqealar haqida.

tasks.prompt: 1  Her parents ............ when she was a young girl.
tasks.whyUz:
'Her parents DIVORCED' = ota-onasi ajrashdi.
DIQQAT: 'divorce' bu yerda 'ajrashmoq' — to'ldiruvchi kerak emas.
4-xatboshida yana chiqadi: 'They finally divorced in 1996'.
tasks.speak: 1  Her parents ............ when she was a young girl.

tasks.prompt: 2  As a child, Diana ............ at a boarding school in Kent.
tasks.whyUz:
'STUDIED at a school' = maktabda o'qidi.
study → studied (undosh + Y → I + ED).
'a boarding school' = internat maktab.
tasks.speak: 2  As a child, Diana ............ at a boarding school in Kent.

tasks.whyUz:
'COMPLETED her education' = ta'limini tugatdi.
'complete' = tugatmoq, yakunlamoq.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').

'RETURNED to England' = Angliyaga qaytdi.
'return TO a place' — 'to' shart.
Shveytsariyadan qaytgan.

tasks.prompt: 5  ... she ............ as a nanny in London.
tasks.whyUz:
'WORKED as a nanny' = enaga bo'lib ishladi.
'work AS' — 'as' shart.
'a nanny' = enaga.
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 2-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi.
tasks.speak: 5  ... she ............ as a nanny in London.

tasks.whyUz:
'MARRIED Prince Charles' = shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.
marry → married (undosh + Y → I + ED).
DIQQAT: 'married WITH Charles' XATO — 'with' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.prompt: 7  People all around the world ............ her wedding on television.
tasks.whyUz:
'WATCHED her wedding' = to'yini tomosha qilishdi.
'watch' — televizor va tomoshalar uchun
('see' emas, WATCH).
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.
tasks.speak: 7  People all around the world ............ her wedding on television.

tasks.prompt: 8  The British ............ her for her kindness and beauty.
tasks.whyUz:
'LOVED her' = uni sevishardi.
'love somebody FOR something' = biror fazilati uchun sevmoq.
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi (T) shu gapdan.
tasks.speak: 8  The British ............ her for her kindness and beauty.

tasks.whyUz:
'CALLED her ...' = uni ... deb atashdi.
'call somebody + nom' — orada predlog YO'Q:
  They called her The People's Princess.  ✓
  They called her AS ...                  ✗ XATO

tasks.prompt: 10  ... because she ............ so much about sick and poor people.
tasks.whyUz:
'CARED about ...' = ... haqida qayg'urardi.
'care ABOUT' = befarq bo'lmaslik.
'care FOR' = parvarish qilmoq (biroz boshqa ma'no).
'so much' = juda ko'p.
tasks.speak: 10  ... because she ............ so much about sick and poor people.

tasks.prompt: 11  She once ............ , "I see myself as a princess for the world ..."
tasks.whyUz:
'SAID' = dedi.
Qo'shtirnoq ochilsa — gapirish fe'li kerak.
DIQQAT: 'say' — NOTO'G'RI fe'l:
  say → SAID  (-ed QO'ShILMAYDI)
Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA noto'g'ri fe'l.
'once' bu yerda = bir marta.
tasks.speak: 11  She once ............ , "I see myself as a princess for the world ..."

tasks.prompt: 12  But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'as happy as it APPEARED' = ko'ringanchalik baxtli.
'to appear' = ko'rinmoq, tuyulmoq.
Ma'nosi: tashqaridan baxtli ko'rinardi, aslida emas —
SHUHRATNING NARXI.
tasks.speak: 12  But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it ............ .

tasks.prompt: 13  Diana ............ to travel round the world and help those in need.
tasks.whyUz:
'CONTINUED to travel' = sayohat qilishni davom ettirdi.
'continue TO + fe'l' qolipi.
'those in need' = muhtojlar.
tasks.speak: 13  Diana ............ to travel round the world and help those in need.

tasks.prompt: 14  She ............ in a car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris.
tasks.whyUz:
'DIED in a car accident' = avtohalokatda halok bo'ldi.
die → died (-e ga faqat -D).
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 4-bandi (F) shu gapga asoslanadi:
poyezd emas, MAShINA halokati.
tasks.speak: 14  She ............ in a car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris.

TO'QQIZ QALIN SO'Z:

tasks.en: Explain the words in bold in the text.

tasks.note:
'She completed her EDUCATION in Switzerland.'
Maktab va oliy o'quv yurtidagi o'qish.
Fe'li: 'to educate' = ta'lim bermoq.

'She worked as a NANNY in London.'
Boshqa oilaning bolalariga qaraydigan ayol.
DIQQAT: 'a nurse' (hamshira) BILAN ADAShTIRMANG —
70-betdagi 3-mashqda shu farq tekshiriladi.

'She married PRINCE Charles.'
Qirol yoki qirolichaning o'g'li.
Ayol jinsi: 'a Princess' = malika.

'People watched her WEDDING on television.'
Turmush qurish MAROSIMI (bir kunlik voqea).
DIQQAT: 'a marriage' — NIKOH (uzoq davom etadigan holat).

'The British loved her for her KINDNESS and beauty.'
Sifat: 'kind' = mehribon.
-NESS qo'shimchasi sifatdan ot yasaydi.

'They called her The People's PRINCESS.'
Shahzodaning xotini yoki qirolning qizi.
-ESS qo'shimchasi ayol jinsini bildiradi:
  prince → princess;  actor → actress;
  waiter → waitress

'she cared about SICK and poor people'
= 'ill' bilan bir xil ma'no.
'sick people' = kasal odamlar.
Oti: 'sickness' = kasallik.

'she cared about sick and POOR people'
Aksi: 'rich' = boy.
DIQQAT: 'poor' ikkinchi ma'noda 'bechora' —
'Poor Diana!' = Bechora Diana!

'They had problems with their MARRIAGE.'
Turmush qurgan HOLAT (uzoq davom etadi).
'a wedding' bilan farqi:
  wedding  = bir kunlik MAROSIM
  marriage = yillar davom etadigan NIKOH
Fe'li: 'to marry' = turmush qurmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article again and match the headings to the paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani yana o'qing va sarlavhalarni xatboshilarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESH SARLAVHA:
  • Everyone Loved Her  (Hamma uni sevardi)
  • Diana's Early Years (Diananing bolalik yillari)
  • The Divorce        (Ajralish)
  • The Tragic End     (Fojiali oxir)
  • The Wedding        (To'y)

Kitob BIRINI bergan:
  Everyone Loved Her → Paragraph 3

USUL: har bir xatboshining ASOSIY mavzusini toping.
  1-xatboshi — tug'ilishi, maktab, birinchi ish
  2-xatboshi — to'y va farzandlar
  3-xatboshi — xalq mehri (BERILGAN)
  4-xatboshi — nikohdagi muammolar va ajralish
  5-xatboshi — halokat va o'lim

Har bir savolning javobi matnda BOR.
To'liq gap bilan javob bering.

SAVOL SO'ZLARI:
  When ...?     → vaqt
  Where ...?    → joy
  How many ...? → son
  Why ...?      → sabab (javob 'Because ...')
  Was ...?      → ha/yo'q (qisqa javob + tushuntirish)

tasks.prompt: 1  When and where was Diana born?
tasks.answer: She was born on 1st July, 1961, in Norfolk, England.
tasks.whyUz:
IKKI savol birga: WHEN (vaqt) + WHERE (joy).
'was born ON + sana' — aniq sana bilan ON.
'IN Norfolk, England' — joy bilan IN.
tasks.speak: 1  When and where was Diana born?

tasks.answer: She studied at a boarding school in Kent and completed her education in Switzerland.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda IKKI joy bor:
'a boarding school in Kent' va 'Switzerland'.
Ikkalasini ham aytish kerak — biri qoldirilsa javob to'liq emas.
'study AT a school' — predlog AT.

tasks.prompt: 3  When and where did she marry Prince Charles?
tasks.answer: She married him in July, 1981, at St Paul's Cathedral in London.
tasks.whyUz:
'IN July, 1981' — oy va yil bilan IN.
'AT St Paul's Cathedral' — aniq bino bilan AT.
Savolda 'did ... marry' (asosiy shakl),
javobda 'married' (o'tgan shakl).
tasks.speak: 3  When and where did she marry Prince Charles?

tasks.prompt: 4  How many children did they have?
tasks.answer: They had two sons, William and Harry.
tasks.whyUz:
'How many ...?' — SANALADIGAN ot bilan.
Javob: ikkita o'g'il — Uilyam va Garri.
Savolda 'did ... have', javobda 'had'.
tasks.speak: 4  How many children did they have?

tasks.answer: Because the British loved her for her kindness and beauty, and because she cared so much about sick and poor people all over the world.
tasks.whyUz:
'Why ...?' savoliga 'BECAUSE ...' bilan javob beriladi.
IKKI sabab bor: mehribonligi/go'zalligi va
kasal-kambag'allarga qayg'urishi.

tasks.prompt: 6  Was her life as happy as it appeared?
tasks.answer: No, it wasn't. She and Charles had problems with their marriage.
tasks.whyUz:
'Was ...?' savoliga qisqa javob: 'No, it wasn't.'
So'ng sabab tushuntiriladi.
'as happy as' — tenglik darajasi.
Bu — unitning asosiy g'oyasi: shuhrat baxt keltirmaydi.
tasks.speak: 6  Was her life as happy as it appeared?

tasks.whyUz:
'IN August, 1996' — oy va yil bilan IN.
Savolda 'did ... divorce', javobda 'divorced'.

tasks.prompt: 8  When and where did she die?
tasks.answer: She died on 31st August, 1997, in a car accident in Paris.
tasks.whyUz:
'ON 31st August, 1997' — aniq sana bilan ON.
'IN Paris' — shahar bilan IN.
'IN a car accident' — halokat bilan IN.
tasks.speak: 8  When and where did she die?

exercises.instructionUz: Matnni yana o'qing va jadvalni to'ldiring.

tasks.whyUz:

Tartib son bilan yoziladi.

tasks.answer: a boarding school in Kent; then in Switzerland

IKKI joy: Kentdagi internat maktab va Shveytsariya.

Ikkita o'g'il: Uilyam va Garri.

4-xatboshining oxirgi gapidan.

Parijda, avtohalokatda.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, talk about Diana, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA BOSHLANISHI:
  Diana Frances Spencer was born on 1st July, 1961, in
  Norfolk, England. ...

Jadvaldagi har bir qatorni GAPGA aylantirasiz.

TO'LIQ NAMUNA MATN:

  Diana Frances Spencer was born on 1st July, 1961, in
  Norfolk, England. She studied at a boarding school in
  Kent and completed her education in Switzerland. She
  married Prince Charles in July, 1981, at St Paul's
  Cathedral in London. They had two sons, William and
  Harry. She was famous for her kindness and beauty, and
  because she cared about sick and poor people. She and
  Charles divorced in August, 1996. She died on 31st
  August, 1997, in a car accident in Paris.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Diana Frensis Spenser 1961-yil 1-iyulda Angliyaning
  Norfolk shahrida tug'ilgan. U Kentdagi internat maktabida
  o'qigan va ta'limini Shveytsariyada tugatgan. 1981-yil
  iyulda Londondagi Avliyo Pavel soborida shahzoda Charlzga
  turmushga chiqqan. Ularning ikkita o'g'li bo'lgan —
  Uilyam va Garri. U mehribonligi va go'zalligi bilan,
  shuningdek kasal va kambag'al odamlarga qayg'urgani
  uchun mashhur edi. U va Charlz 1996-yil avgustda
  ajrashishgan. U 1997-yil 31-avgustda Parijda
  avtohalokatda halok bo'lgan.

DIQQAT — PREDLOGLAR:
  ON + aniq sana    → on 1st July, 1961
  IN + oy yoki yil  → in July;  in 1961
  IN + shahar/mamlakat → in Norfolk;  in Paris
  AT + aniq bino    → at St Paul's Cathedral
  AT + maktab       → at a boarding school

tasks.answer: Diana Frances Spencer was born on 1st July, 1961, in Norfolk, England.
She studied at a boarding school in Kent and completed her education in Switzerland.
She married Prince Charles in July, 1981, at St Paul's Cathedral in London.
They had two sons, William and Harry.
She was famous for her kindness and beauty, and because she cared about sick and poor people.
She and Charles divorced in August, 1996.
She died on 31st August, 1997, in a car accident in Paris.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Yozilishi bir xil, o'qilishi uch xil.

items.derivedUz: k, ch, p, s, f, sh dan keyin
v, l, r, n, m, unli dan keyin

wordFormation.explanationUz: Sifatga -ness qo'shilib mavhum ot hosil bo'ladi.
Ba'zi kasb va unvonlarda ayol jinsi -ess bilan.
Tarjimai hol yozishda eng ko'p kerak bo'ladi.
O'zbekchada predlog bordek tuyuladi, lekin ingliz tilida YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHO WAS + ism?  →  He/She WAS + a/an/the + kasb.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who was John F. Kennedy? — He was an American president.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon F. Kennedi kim edi? — U amerikalik prezident edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kasb oldidan artikl SHART.
Ko'pchilikdan biri → a/an;  yagona unvon → the.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN WAS he/she BORN?  →  He/She WAS BORN IN + yil.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was he born? — He was born in 1917.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat, 'was/were' SHART.
'I born' XATO.  Yil oldidan IN.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN DID he/she DIE?  →  He/She DIED IN + yil.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When did he die? — He died in 1963.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qachon vafot etgan? — U 1963-yilda vafot etgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'did' + ASOSIY shakl (die).
Javobda fe'lning o'tgan shakli (died).
'was died' XATO — 'die' majhul nisbat olmaydi.

'work AS' = ...bo'lib ishlamoq — 'as' SHART.
'work like a nurse' boshqa ma'no beradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: The British LOVED her FOR her + fazilat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The British loved her for her kindness and beauty.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Britaniyaliklar uni mehribonligi va go'zalligi uchun sevishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'love somebody FOR something' = biror fazilati uchun sevmoq.
'the British' — millat nomi oldidan THE.

sentencePatterns.formula: She DIED IN a + halokat turi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She died in a car accident.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'die IN an accident' — predlog IN.
'die OF an illness' — kasallikdan bo'lsa OF.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS BORN ON + sana, IN + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Diana Frances Spencer was born on 1st July, 1961, in Norfolk, England.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Diana Frensis Spenser 1961-yil 1-iyulda Angliyaning Norfolk shahrida tug'ilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat.
Aniq sana → ON;  joy → IN.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + MARRIED + kim + IN + oy/yil + AT + bino.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She married Prince Charles in July, 1981, at St Paul's Cathedral in London.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1981-yil iyulda Londondagi Avliyo Pavel soborida shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They called her "The People's Princess" because she cared so much about sick and poor people.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular uni "Xalq Malikasi" deb atashdi, chunki u kasal va kambag'al odamlar haqida qayg'urardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'call somebody + nom' — orada predlog YO'Q.
'because' sababni bog'laydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Her life wasn't AS happy AS it appeared.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it appeared.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Lekin Diananing hayoti ko'ringanchalik baxtli emas edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'AS + sifat + AS' — tenglik darajasi.
Inkorda 'unchalik ...emas' ma'nosini beradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Diana continued to travel round the world and help those in need.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Diana dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishni va muhtojlarga yordam berishni davom ettirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'continue TO + fe'l' qolipi.
Ikkinchi fe'l ('help') oldidan 'to' takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + DIED ON + sana, IN + halokat, IN + shahar.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She died on 31st August, 1997, in a car accident in Paris.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'die' — oddiy fe'l ('was died' XATO).
Halokat va shahar bilan IN.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She was famous for her kindness and beauty.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mehribonligi va go'zalligi bilan mashhur edi.
